'''Dark side tendrils''' were pure manifestations of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|malevolent]] [[The Force/Legends|Force energy]] summoned through [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]]. These tendrils rose in the form of [[black]] mist from the ground and took the form of serpentine tentacles which swarmed their victim and attacked with the power of the pure dark side. Exceptionally powerful and difficult to conjure, this [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] required complete mental concentration. When conjured by a seasoned [[Sith sorcerer]], dark side tendrils were able to instantly annihilate any kind of matter they contacted, as well as subject the individual who got injured to the full scope of the void of the dark side. [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] sorceress [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] summoned dark side tendrils against her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], while they [[Duel on Ambria (980 BBY)|dueled]] each other on [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] in [[980 BBY]].<ref name="doe" /> Nearly a thousand years later in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], dejected [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|trainee]] [[Kyp Durron]] invoked the power of dark side tendrils with assistance from the [[Force ghost/Legends|ghost]] of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] against [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="swda">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref>
